differential.name: Myelodysplastic syndrome
differential.rationale: Elderly patient with anemia and critically low platelet MPV suggesting marrow dysplasia.

differential.name: Iron deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Common cause of anemia in older adults; may coexist with low platelet production.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease
differential.rationale: Chronic ischemic heart disease and inflammatory burden can suppress erythropoiesis.

differential.name: Aplastic anemia
differential.rationale: Pancytopenia with low platelet indices could reflect bone‑marrow failure.

differential.name: Immune thrombocytopenic purpura (ITP)
differential.rationale: Isolated platelet abnormality in the setting of anemia, though less typical in this age group.
